16: export async function verify (req: Request, res: Response) {

18: 
19:   try {
20:     const { userId, type } = security.verify(tmpToken) && security.decode(tmpToken)

22:     if (type !== 'password_valid_needs_second_factor_token') {
23:       throw new Error('Invalid token type')
24:     }
25: 
26:     const user = await UserModel.findByPk(userId)
27:     if (user == null) {
28:       throw new Error('No such user found!')
29:     }
30: 
31:     const isValid = verifySync({ secret: user.totpSecret, token: totpToken, epochTolerance: 30 }).valid
32: 
33:     const plainUser = utils.queryResultToJson(user)
34: 
35:     if (!isValid) {
36:       return res.status(401).send()
37:     }
38:     challengeUtils.solveIf(challenges.twoFactorAuthUnsafeSecretStorageChallenge, () => { return user.email === 'wurstbrot@' + config.get<string>('application.domain') })
39: 
40:     const [basket] = await BasketModel.findOrCreate({ where: { UserId: userId } })
41: 
42:     const token = security.authorize(plainUser)
43:     // @ts-expect-error FIXME set new property for original basket
44:     plainUser.bid = basket.id // keep track of original basket for challenge solution check
45:     security.authenticatedUsers.put(token, plainUser)
46: 
47:     res.json({ authentication: { token, bid: basket.id, umail: user.email } })
48:   } catch (error) {
49:     res.status(401).send()
50:   }
51: }
